reselect_slow: Reselecting a reachable evacuation site assuming a slow walk. Follow the screen and voice guidance.
reselect_wheelchair: Reselecting a nearby evacuation site assuming wheelchair use. Ask nearby people for help to reach upper floors.
ask_floor: Go up to the 3rd floor or higher, preferably higher. The floor is a guideline.
road_blocked: Do not use that road. Reselecting another evacuation site.
lost_family: Do not go back to search now; evacuate yourself first. Search at an evacuation shelter after the warning is lifted.
injured: Continue evacuating if you can move. If you cannot move, ask nearby people for help.
when_to_return: Tsunamis strike multiple times. Do not return until the warning is lifted.
other: Sorry, I did not understand. Select from the buttons on the screen.
